steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: First, let's get a little music going!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright, you've been waiting for two days, and now we're on the brink of the championship's Round 2—the Triathlon!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: The rules are simple as could be. First you run, then you ride, and finally you swim!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Obstructing competitors? No problem! As long as one of your teammates finishes, you pass!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Shortcuts are fair game, but careful of who's lying within the alleys! They're not gonna roll over and let you through!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Furthermore, if you reach the finish, but the cycling and swimming checkpoints never saw you, then that's not gonna count!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: In other words, contestants, nothing's stopping you from spinning around and diving in at the start line—if you wanna be the laughing stock of the whole city.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: If you're someone who's got it made and you wanna hitch on a low-altitude aircraft, sure!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But, if the audience doesn't like that, you might just get booted out at the votes!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Further, as fifteen teams directly passed Round 1, along with one team being revived thanks to audience voting, sixteen teams in total made it out.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Thus, eight teams will pass Round 2.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: That's the first eight teams to make it who get the right to pass!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Well, then, let's invite those sixteen teams up onto the stage!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: What a beautiful sea...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: It really is.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Looks like we wasted nothing coming to this city.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: How about we sit down right here, then.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: We could also head back. I'm worried we'll be a nuisance to the others here...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Don't let it weigh on you. This city doesn't seem to mind the Infected too much.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Though it's very plainly not because they're open-minded, but because they don't care...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Besides, we have Sussurro with us. We'll be fine, right?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Yes. I'm well aware of Eyjafjalla's condition.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: In my honest opinion, you should worry more about yourself than if you're troubling anyone else.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: You spend more time indoors than the average person, and that doesn't just have repercussions on your body, but your mental health as well.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: That's why I, as a doctor, endorsed bringing you here, Eyjafjalla.

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Everyone should have the right to enjoy the sunshine.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Absolutely.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: They ran into some trouble, but I heard over the screen that the Doctor took a group on vacation somewhere.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: It's only right that Eyjafjalla and the rest of us get one too.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: No, I came voluntarily to carry out geological research, and if I hold up everyone else...

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Aw, come on, now, don't you worry so much.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: We came here on legitimate grounds, too. Rhodes Island wants to set up a branch office here, and we've never been able to get the mayor's approval.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Amiya's had us come here as a liaison.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: So you just relax and enjoy the competition.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Mhm. Thanks.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh, right. Where's Projekt Red?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: I don't think she's coming here. She went off alone somewhere.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Fine. She's been like this since forever. I'm used to it.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Oh, look! They're up, they're up!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Let's welcome—LUNG wRATh!

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Ahaha.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Maybe we should split up?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The Triathlon's extremely long. We'll lose contact fast if we all do our own thing.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Save for any teams sending lone people off to obstruct others, it's principally as a joint effort.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If you two have no opinions along that line, then I suggest we work together.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No objections.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's acceptable. So long as you don't hinder me in a fight.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And the very same to you.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Who knew? I thought I was seeing things when I first saw her on the TV, but Ch'en really is here too.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: On her own vacation, I guess. After the competition's over, let's go say hello to her.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Sideroca
steps.text: Brilliant. You two can watch, I'll go buy you some food. Stay right here and don't wander off, okay?

steps.name: Sussurro
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: And that's your introduction to all sixteen teams.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Just like Round 1, you audience-siders get the chance to place your bets here and splash in even more competition joy.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: All spectators are invited to register your info on the government site, and you can make yourself a little extra cash!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: For specifics on how it'll work, refer to your government-issued competition guides.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: During Round 2, you'll find our honored guest in a slightly different place.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Mr. Pancho's already headed for the cruise ship to prepare Round 3, so he'll be talking with you via video feed.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Alright, the contestants are all at the ready line! Let's have Lady Candela up for us to fire off the Round 2 salute!

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: You have fun, all you youngsters. I declare—Round 2 has officially begun!

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It looks like we're being watched again.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Let's finish this quickly.
